versions.headline: Easier to get back where you were.

items.text: Back on every panel the ⋯ menu opens.
Theme asks for your Day theme, then your Night one.
Everything has its own bar, count and finale.
The same check, in colours of its own instead of borrowed ones.
New devices start on Paper by day, Terminal by night.
Dark is still Dark, and whatever theme you picked is still yours.
The same list on the iPhone, with a check-off you can feel.
Crossing off, taking one back and finishing the day each feel different.
A check-off settles in half the time; a list keeps one day everywhere.
Settings is three short groups; Share leads with the link you came for.
Sketch and Arcade; every pack on a theme; a sound for Day and Night.

versions.headline: A little something for someone in particular.

items.text: If you know, you know.
Every screen reads right the first time.
A list with a chosen-days repeat opens whole again.
A hold opens the menu, the first check-off sounds, dead links carry over.
Six new sound packs: kalimba, pencil, whistle, bongos, cork and arcade.
Each one has its own finale for the last line of the day.
Lists know whether they are yours or shared with you.
Share is laid out by what you are doing—another device, a screen, a friend.
Every panel has a way back, and the Home Screen steps fit iOS 26.
The welcome is a list you can try before you keep it.
Links say what they do, and saving yours fits your device.
Shake, press S, or tap ↻ to shuffle in one-thing mode.
Pick a Day theme and a Night theme; the sun and moon flip them.
Every theme has a partner one tap away. Your own can make theirs.
Shorter update notes, like this one.
A line shows its menu on hover or hold.
Fewer controls up top, and they fade while you work.
Your own theme can carry a sound.
Repeating lines, Not today, one-thing mode, search, templates, add from anywhere.
One Settings sheet, and delete a list everywhere with ten seconds to undo.
Sound on the iPhone after a call.
